prompts.standing:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D RPG character sprite atlas, exact uniform 4 columns x 8 rows, 1024 wide x 2048 high (32 square cells). Reference image is ONLY a style/costume/identity reference for the same eight classes, not an edit target.
Style: original late-1990s Lineage PC dark medieval isometric RPG, crisp small prerendered pixel texture, realistic adult proportions, aged metal/leather/cloth, restrained earthy colors; no chibi, cartoon, anime, glossy modern mobile-game look.
Grid: EACH row has columns [male idle, SAME male open-hand greeting, female idle, SAME female open-hand greeting]. Male/female pairs must have matching class costume, with clearly readable adult sex and hair differences. Fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera, face lower right/viewer. Every full-body character stays wholly within central 65% of its own cell, identical scale across grid. Ground contact at 88% cell height, center x=50%; tallest standing head at 10%. No bleed between cells. Each idle/wave pair registered to identical feet/torso anchor; change only raised hand for greeting.
Row order: 1 royal prince/princess, burgundy tunic, muted gold crown, ivory cape, dark brown hair; 2 knight, worn silver plate armor, dark short male hair, female dark ponytail; 3 elf, green woodland leather, long blond hair, pointed ears; 4 mage, dark robes with muted purple lining, elderly bearded male and long black-haired female; 5 dark elf, dark blue-grey skin, silver hair, dark leather; 6 dragon knight, tarnished red/bronze scale armor, brown hair; 7 illusionist, deep purple/teal robes and long grey hair; 8 warrior, heavy dark leather/iron shoulder armor, reddish brown hair.
Pose: All 32 characters STANDING at ease on both feet, relaxed hips, hands resting naturally. Idle columns have lowered hands; greeting columns raise the right open hand at shoulder height. No seated or kneeling figures.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the character. No labels/text/numbers, borders, grid lines, watermark, scenery, ground plane, furniture, checkerboard, colored rectangles, drawn weapons raised, or prop that crosses a cell boundary. Gentle campfire warm edge light. Production game atlas: exact eight rows, four columns, all 32 full bodies completely present and separated by empty transparent space. The reference image is not to be copied with its colored background artifacts.
